necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Given the history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9), a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias. This service is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances as indicated by the clinical presentation.
